fields.html:
Assess your Back Pain

Hey there! This assessment tool is designed by our experts. We will ask you a series of questions to better understand your symptoms. Based on a differential analysis of your responses, this tool will generate a preliminary diagnosis for you. This process should take about 5–10 minutes. Find a quiet corner, and let’s get started!

Please note that your information shared here is completely safe and is used only for arriving at the assessment results. The assessment results are indicative and do not substitute medical expert consultation in any way. Appropriate user discretion is advised. You may refer to our Terms of Service for further clarity.

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Muscle knots, also known as myofascial trigger points, are tight, contracted areas within muscle fibers that develop when muscles are overused, injured, or subjected to prolonged tension.

fields.label: 2. Do you experience unbearable pain or stiffness in other joints of the body as well?

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Arthritis is a condition where the joints become swollen, painful, and stiff, making movement harder. It can happen for different reasons, with osteoarthritis (wear and tear arthritis) and rheumatoid arthritis (auto-immune arthritis) being the most common.

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Tailbone pain, or coccydynia, happens when the coccyx (tailbone) gets bruised or stressed from sitting on hard surfaces, an injury, or childbirth, making it painful to sit or stand up.

fields.label: 4. Do you experience the following symptoms ?

choices.value: Difficulty in urinating or in bowel movements
choices.label: Difficulty in urinating or in bowel movements

choices.value: Any loss of muscle tone or muscle size in your legs
choices.label: Any loss of muscle tone or muscle size in your legs

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Back pain, especially in the lower back, can sometimes be linked to issues with urination, as pressure on nerves or the bladder can interfere with normal urinary function.

fields.label: 5. Pain on a scale - 1 being the least amount of pain and 10 being the highest (Options to presented as a visual scale)

choices.label: 1 - Mild - Pain is very mild, barely noticeable
2 - Minor - Annoying and may have occassional sudden bouts of the localized pain
3 - Uncomfortable - Pain is noticeable and distracting but bearable
4 - Moderate - Distracting when not involved in an activity
5 - Distracting - Moderately strong pain, it cant be ignored for more than a few minutes
6 - Distressing - Moderately strong pain that interferes with daily activities
7 - Severe - Pain that limits your ability to perform daily activity
8 - Intense - Physical activity is severely limited
9 - Excruciating - Unable to converse. Crying out uncontrollably

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Sciatica is pain that shoots down your leg, starting from your lower back. It happens when something presses on the nerve that runs from your back to your legs, causing pain, tingling, or numbness.

choices.label: Known Spinal deformities (uneven shoulders/hips/waist OR hunchback OR unusual forward curve in neck/lowerback)

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Back pain during pregnancy is common, as the growing belly puts extra strain on the lower back, while hormonal changes loosen the ligaments, making the spine more vulnerable.

fields.label: 7. Which activities seem to trigger or worsen your pain?

fields.html:
Did You Know?

Bending forward may help relieve back pain related to disc issues by increasing space between the vertebrae, while bending backward may help when pain originates from the facet joints by reducing pressure on them.

fields.label: Muscle Lower Back
fields.default: Your symptoms are most likely due to the Muscular Imbalance arising due to the deconditioning of your back muscles because of years of wear & tear and neglect. To keep your back functioning optimally, it's essential to balance muscle length and strength between opposing muscle groups. As you age, the muscles, tendons, and ligaments become thicker and less flexible, increasing the risk of injury. With a proper self-care routine, you can prevent further damage and reverse some of the damage already done. The betterhoodTM routine focuses on targeted muscle strengthening and postural correction to alleviate spinal misalignment, reduce excessive loading, and enhance bone density and tissue recovery.

fields.label: Nerve Lower Back
fields.default: Your symptoms are most likely due to the Compressed Nerves due to various underlying muskuloskeletal issues. Your spine is the key pathway for your spinal cord, linking your brain to nerves in your arms, legs, and trunk. With 31 pairs of nerves branching from the spinal cord, any compression or damage can lead to pain. This often results from wear and tear on spinal bones, joints, or disks. With a proper self-care routine, you can prevent further damage and reverse some of the damage already done. The betterhoodTM routine focuses on targeted muscle strengthening and postural correction to alleviate spinal misalignment, reduce excessive loading, and enhance bone density and tissue recovery.

fields.label: Bone Lower Back
fields.default: Your symptoms are most likely due to the Spinal Instability arising due to the poor bone health. As you age, bone density decreases (osteoporosis), making bones more prone to fractures. Spinal fractures can cause instability, leading to painful vertebra slippage. Additionally, aging causes your spinal disks to flatten or break down, worsening spinal instability. With a proper self-care routine, you can prevent further damage and reverse some of the damage already done. The betterhoodTM routine focuses on targeted muscle strengthening and postural correction to alleviate spinal misalignment, reduce excessive loading, and enhance bone density and tissue recovery.

fields.label: Joint Lower Back
fields.default: Your symptoms are most likely due to the excessive wear and tear of spinal joints. Your spine consists of 33 different bones connected by spinal joints. As you age, excessive strain on spinal joints from improper posture or weak muscles wear down the protective tissues, leading to osteoarthritis and pain. The bony outgrowths that form as a result can further increase the pain. With a proper self-care routine, you can prevent further damage and reverse some of the damage already done. The betterhoodTM routine focuses on targeted muscle strengthening and postural correction to alleviate spinal misalignment, reduce excessive loading, and enhance bone density and tissue recovery.
